snippet.title: Coffee Talk Tokyo is Out Now
snippet.description:
The café is finally open.

Coffee Talk Tokyo is now available worldwide on Steam (PC), PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, and Nintendo Switch 2.

Step back behind the counter in the neon lit streets of Tokyo and serve carefully crafted drinks to humans and supernatural beings alike. Listen to their stories, shape relationships through conversation, and discover a new chapter in the beloved Coffee Talk universe.

Featuring:
• Hot and iced drink brewing
• Stencil latte art
• Expanded Tomodachill social system
• A brand new cast inspired by Japanese culture and mythology
• Lo fi soundtrack by Andrew “AJ” Jeremy

Available now:

Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3161220/Coffee_Talk_Tokyo/

PlayStation Store:
https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10012616

Xbox:
https://www.xbox.com/en-us/games/store/coffee-talk-tokyo/9nn3lkf38fr4 

Nintendo Switch:
https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/coffee-talk-tokyo-switch/
